C-49.Name: One clear zoom: ⌘+ / ⌘− / ⌘0 and pinch scale text, tables, code, math and diagrams; View menu items
C-49.Summary: Today Mark has two unrelated zooms: (1) ⌘+/⌘−/⌘0 and Ctrl+wheel/pinch change the editor fontSize 12–36 (pages/app.vue setupZoomKeysFontSize / setupCtrlWheelFontSize; ⌘0 resets to a hard 16) — text, tables, code and KaTeX scale, Mermaid diagrams do not (measured 2026-10-15: 247 px, 16 px labels before and after); (2) a palette-only percentage zoom (commands file.zoom-*, preference `zoom`, app.vue watch → mt::window-zoom). Nothing is in the native View menu.

Problem.Description: User 2026-10-15: «зум текста и элементов всех это прям нужная вещь, нужно проверить как реализовано и в скринах про это сказать»; approved C-49 («да»).

Goals.R-1: One zoom: ⌘+ / ⌘− / ⌘0, Ctrl+wheel and pinch change the content scale via fontSize (12–36). Mermaid diagrams scale with it: their max width and labels grow proportionally to fontSize / 16 while they still fit the column (useMaxWidth keeps them inside the column).
Goals.R-2: ⌘0 "Actual Size" returns to the size set in Settings (the persisted base font size), not a hard 16. Introduce a separate base preference if needed so ⌘+ / ⌘− do not overwrite the user's Settings choice — or document that they do and ⌘0 restores the default; pick the simpler behaviour that never loses the user's Settings value.
Goals.R-3: Native View menu (macOS and Windows/Linux menus): Zoom In (CmdOrCtrl+=), Zoom Out (CmdOrCtrl+-), Actual Size (CmdOrCtrl+0), wired to the same commands; menu-consistency test updated.
Goals.R-4: Retire the palette percentage zoom (file.zoom-*): remove the commands; a stored `zoom` ≠ 1 is migrated once into an equivalent fontSize (round(16 × zoom), clamped) and reset to 1.
Goals.R-5: A small transient indicator ("120 %") appears for ~1 s when the zoom changes.
Goals.R-6: The fullscreen block viewer keeps its own zoom and never changes the editor size (already fixed in 0f6b4df9; keep the e2e).

Z1.Title: Unified zoom + diagram scaling + menu + migration + indicator

C-49.Dependencies: M-011 editor, M-009 menu, C-34 mermaid pipeline (useMaxWidth).

Constraints.Constraint: No user loses their font-size setting; images keep their own size.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: ⌘+ ×6 grows text, tables, code, math and diagram labels proportionally (diagram still inside the column); ⌘0 returns to the Settings size; View menu shows the three items with shortcuts; a stored zoom 1.25 opens as fontSize 20.

AffectedAreas.M-011: pages/app.vue zoom handlers, mermaid pipeline scaling, commands, preferences migration

C-49.VerificationIntent: Unit tests for migration and clamping; e2e (Chromium + WebKit) measuring each element type before/after ⌘+, ⌘0, the indicator; menu-consistency pin; cargo test m009.
C-49.Closure: Closed 2026-10-15 on the user's request to finish epics. Unified zoom (fontSize 12–36, baseFontSize, View menu zoom trio, Mermaid --mark-zoom scaling, indicator, percentage zoom retired with migration); review fixes: codeFontSize '14px' parse (code zoom regression), TS test files, hoisted mocks; npm test 3576, cargo m009 16/16, e2e zoom 10/10 Chromium+WebKit. Live ⌘0-after-broadcast check folded into the 2.3.1 smoke.
